mapper.select: SELECT id, road_id, postal_id, detail, road_address_text, jibun_address_text, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at FROM address WHERE id = #{addressId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (road_id, postal_id, detail, road_address_text, jibun_address_text, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{roadId}, #{postalId}, #{detail}, #{roadAddressText}, #{jibunAddressText}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET road_id = #{roadId}, postal_id = #{postalId}, detail = #{detail}, road_address_text = #{roadAddressText}, jibun_address_text = #{jibunAddressText}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude} WHERE id = #{addressId}
